parts.text: Using the configured inputs from the last evaluator task plus the specification it produced, write the complete AI-NLE procedure now. The procedure must be JWRS and must define how to execute a message to Gemini while setting the response type, input files, heuristic or instructions, and every other previously used information/instruction/configuration category evidenced by the supplied data. Return exact executable code under gemini-message-executor.js, exact workflow YAML under gemini-message-workflow.yaml, and a verbose config.json template for this task. The config must expose the full evidenced configuration surface with concise keys, and the JavaScript/YAML/config must agree exactly.
